query_aliases: best prime lens for street photography
profile_notes: The street archetype is a compact, fast normal-to-wide prime in the classic 28 / 35 / 40 / 50mm (full-frame-equivalent) range, with 35mm the most versatile. optical_performance is weighted highest (3): street primes are chosen for sharpness and are usable wide open. handling (2) stands in for the compactness / low-profile / quick-to-use character that defines a street lens (there is no size axis; physical size lives in the weight_g / dimensions_mm specs, which are populated on only ~2/38 lens cards). bokeh (1) and color_rendition (1) carry the subject-isolation and rendering 'character' street shooters value, and af_performance (1) reflects the value of quick focus on fleeting moments, all held at 1 so they support rather than crown the sharp-and-compact signature. GATE = require:[] BY NECESSITY, not preference: the intended street gate (a focal-length ceiling around 50mm plus a fast max-aperture floor) CANNOT be authored today, because neither focal_length_mm nor max_aperture is in the engine's predicate vocab (specs.py KNOWN_PREDICATES = resolution_mp, card_slots, sensor_format, iso_native, ibis_stops). A require on either would (a) fail C1 validate_profile ('not a known spec predicate') and (b) resolve to UNKNOWN for every lens, dumping the entire corpus into pending_backfill. Until the predicate lands, the normal/wide-prime preference is expressed through weights, query_aliases, and lexicon only. NOT weighted: distortion and af_noise (quiet AF = discretion) were considered and are genuinely street-relevant, but are left out to keep the lens focused on its true signature (sharp + compact + rendering); both are well-populated and are the first candidates if Lee wants to broaden. OPEN FOR LEE: to turn on the intended hard gate, add trivial numeric resolvers for focal_length_mm and max_aperture to _RESOLVERS in specs.py (both parse cleanly: '35' -> 35, 'f/1.4' -> 1.4; note zoom cards store the LONG end of focal_length_mm). PROPOSED gate once available: require focal_length_mm <= 50 (keeps 28/35/40/50 primes and wider; drops 85mm+ and long zooms) and max_aperture <= 2.8 (keeps compact f/2.8 primes and faster) — numbers to be ratified. Ratified by Lee 2026-09-14.
